definitions.explanation: A painting that depicts recognizable things such as people, landscapes or objects, as opposed to abstract painting.

examples.japanese: {具象画|ぐしょうが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抽象画|ちゅうしょうが}→抽象画：33249_chuushouga⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{具象画|ぐしょうが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: He prefers representational painting to abstract painting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{具象画|ぐしょうが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いていた→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{晩年|ばんねん}→晩年：27495_bannen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抽象|ちゅうしょう}→抽象：08670_chuushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The painter, who did representational work when young, turned to abstraction in later years.

notes:
⟦{具象|ぐしょう}→具象：22942_gushou⟧ (concrete, representational) + {画|が} (painting).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{抽象画|ちゅうしょうが}→抽象画：33249_chuushouga⟧: abstract painting, the opposite
- {人物画|じんぶつが}: figure painting
- ⟦{風景画|ふうけいが}→風景画：28196_fuukeiga⟧: landscape painting
- ⟦{静物画|せいぶつが}→静物画：33245_seibutsuga⟧: still life

USAGE:
An art-world term. In everyday speech people more often say ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ or describe what is painted.
